business_summary: Nippi,Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells collagen casing and gelatin products in Japan, Thailand, rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Collagen Casing Business, Gelatin-Related Business, Cosmetics Related Business, Leather-Related Business, Rental and Real Estate Business, and Food and Other Businesses segments. The company offers collagen casings for use in various fields, including sausages, other food, medicine and medical care, and cosmetics; gelatin products, which is used in food, pharmaceuticals, and photo films; collagen peptides for the food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic industries; leather products for shoes, bags, automobiles, and other leather-related products; and collagen-based cosmetics, skin and health care, and functional food products. It also provides functional polymers comprising Nippi Linker cross-linked polyvinyl chloride (PVC) films and sheets, and cross-linked PVC compounds for electric wires and cables; and Nippi V foam PVC quilting cloth and foam products. In addition, the company offers pet supplements, and test regents and kits for animals; and life science products, such as low endotoxin gelatin products, recombinant human laminin protein for iPS cell culture substrates, lab equipment and supplies, and substrates and reagents for research. Further, it engages in the development of urban renewal projects; leasing land, buildings, and equipment; and import and sale of Italian food ingredients, organic grains, fertilizers, other chemical products, linkers, and BSE testing. The company was formerly known as The Japan Leather Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippi,Incorporated in February 1974. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Adachi, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Nippi,Incorporated는 자회사와 함께 일본, 태국, 기타 아시아 지역, 북미, 유럽 및 국제적으로 콜라겐 케이싱 및 젤라틴 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 콜라겐 케이싱 사업, 젤라틴 관련 사업, 화장품 관련 사업, 가죽 관련 사업, 임대 및 부동산 사업, 식품 및 기타 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 소시지, 기타 식품, 의약품 및 의료, 화장품 등 다양한 분야에 사용되는 콜라겐 케이싱을 제공합니다. 식품, 의약품, 사진필름 등에 사용되는 젤라틴 제품; 식품, 제약, 화장품 산업용 콜라겐 펩타이드; 신발, 가방, 자동차용 가죽제품 및 기타 가죽 관련 제품; 콜라겐을 베이스로 한 화장품, 스킨케어, 헬스케어, 기능성식품 등을 판매하고 있습니다. 또한 Nippi Linker 가교 폴리염화비닐(PVC) 필름 및 시트, 전선 및 케이블용 가교 PVC 화합물로 구성된 기능성 폴리머를 제공합니다. Nippi V 폼 PVC 퀼팅천 및 폼 제품 등이 있습니다. 또한 회사는 애완동물 보조제, 동물용 테스트 리전트 및 키트를 제공합니다. 및 생명과학 제품(예: 저급)
